decisions.reason: The draft adds that Sen stood beside Aaron when his classification was issued. The frozen source establishes only that she knew his classification; the checked ledgers and bible do not place her at that event. This is an unsupported historical continuity fact outside the invention budget.

The draft assigns Sen the exact age twenty-five during her Directorate involvement. The frozen source says only that she was young, and no checked authority supplies that age. The number therefore creates an unsupported birth-year and timeline constraint outside the invention budget.
